episodes.title: AKA Ladies Night
episodes.summary: A couple from Omaha ask hard-drinking PI Jessica Jones to find their missing daughter. However, Jessica soon discovers that the man responsible tormented her years ago... and is back for more.

episodes.title: AKA Crush Syndrome
episodes.summary: Jessica tracks down Kilgrave to provide Jeri with enough evidence to convince her that a mind-controller exists so that the lawyer will represent Hope. Meanwhile, Jessica and Luke draw closer after a barfight after they both realize the other is more than they seem.

episodes.title: AKA It's Called Whiskey
episodes.summary: While Jessica tries to get the anesthesia she needs to negate Kilgrave's mind control powers, Trish interviews Hope on her radio show and makes herself Kilgrave's next target.

episodes.title: AKA 99 Friends
episodes.summary: A woman, Audrey Freeman, hires Jessica to get photos of her cheating husband. Jessica suspects that it's another of Kilgrave's traps and follows Audrey to confirm that she's legit. Meanwhile, Trish's radio show brings in a number of Kilgrave's victims, and Jessica finds a clue to Kilgrave's spy.

episodes.title: AKA The Sandwich Saved Me
episodes.summary: While Jessica, Trish, and Will try to get close enough to Kilgrave to drug him, Jessica remembers her burgeoning career as a superhero and how she fell under Kilgrave's control.

episodes.title: AKA You're a Winner!
episodes.summary: Luke hires Jessica to track down a teenager whose sister holds evidence showing who killed Luke's wife Reva. Meanwhile, Kilgrave decides to buy a house without using his powers on the owner, while Jessica finds out who hired Sissy to beat Hope.

episodes.title: AKA Top Shelf Perverts
episodes.summary: After Kilgrave strikes at someone close to Jessica, she vows to get herself imprisoned in the hopes that they can capture Kilgrave. However, Kilgrave has other plans. Meanwhile, Will ignores Trish's orders and hunts down Kilgrave on his own.

episodes.title: AKA WWJD?
episodes.summary: Jessica has no choice but to meet Kilgrave on his own turf... her childhood home. Meanwhile, Will tries to murder Kilgrave and lies to Trish about what he's planning.

episodes.title: AKA Sin Bin
episodes.summary: Jessica tries to force Kilgrave to reveal his powers on video so she can get Hope free. Meanwhile, Wendy increases her demands in the divorce settlement, and Jeri begins considering alternatives.

episodes.title: AKA 1,000 Cuts
episodes.summary: While Albert struggles to make a vaccine to counter his son's mind control power, Jessica makes a deal with Kilgrave to free Hope. Meanwhile, Wendy takes out her frustrations on Jeri, and Robyn discovers what happened to her brother.

episodes.title: AKA I've Got the Blues
episodes.summary: Jessica tries to track down Kilgrave by finding Albert's corpse at the city morgues. Meanwhile, Will asks Trish for a second chance but he has an ulterior motive. In the past, the Walkers take Jessica in and the girl soon discovers what Dorothy is really like.

episodes.title: AKA Take a Bloody Number
episodes.summary: Dorothy tries to buy her way back into Trish's life with information about the people backing Kozlov. Meanwhile, Jessica and Luke try to track down Kilgrave and grow closer.

episodes.title: AKA Smile
episodes.summary: Jessica and Trish prepare for the final showdown against Kilgrave, but things don't go as planned. Meanwhile, nurse Claire Temple helps Luke when the doctors are unable to treat him due to his impenetrable skin.

episodes.title: AKA Start at the Beginning
episodes.summary: Jessica is drowning her guilt over killing Killgrave in alcohol and meaningless cases. Trish insists on digging up Jessica's past to learn more about IGH, and a client who IGH experimented on comes to Jessica asking for help. Meanwhile, Jeri gets some disturbing news and a rival detective firm offers to buy Alias Investigations out.

episodes.title: AKA Freak Accident
episodes.summary: While Jessica tries to find Whizzer's killer, Trish conducts her own investigation and recruits Malcolm to help her. Meanwhile, Jeri deals with her medical condition in her own unique way.

episodes.title: AKA Sole Survivor
episodes.summary: Jessica gets a lead on the doctor who sent her to IGH, but the confrontation doesn't go as expected. Meanwhile, Trish chafes at Jessica's attempts to protect her, and Malcolm meets with the landlord to figure out why he's letting Oscar force Jessica to leave.

episodes.title: AKA God Help the Hobo
episodes.summary: Jessica and Trish try to track down the third IGH patient. Meanwhile, Pryce makes Malcolm an offer, and Jeri gives her doctor an ultimatum.

episodes.title: AKA The Octopus
episodes.summary: On Jeri's advice, Jessica comes clean with the cops. She then gets Oscar to help her get in to see the man who supposedly killed Luanne. Meanwhile, Trish gets an unexpected proposal.

episodes.title: AKA Facetime
episodes.summary: Jessica continues her search for Malus and the mystery woman. Meanwhile, Trish starts to go through drug withdrawal, Malcolm confronts his past, and Inez confronts Jeri over her ALS.

episodes.title: AKA I Want Your Cray Cray
episodes.summary: Alisa tells Jessica how she ended up with IGH, and how she was once a part of Jessica's life.

episodes.title: AKA Ain't We Got Fun
episodes.summary: Jessica and Alisa sit down for a heart-to-heart, while Trish tells Malcolm what she's been doing with the inhaler.

episodes.title: AKA Shark in the Bathtub, Monster in the Bed
episodes.summary: When Jessica discovers who the shooter is, Alisa wants to kill him but her daughter has other plans. Meanwhile, Jeri blackmails Shane into helping her, and Trish gets a surprising offer.

episodes.title: AKA Pork Chop
episodes.summary: Jessica tries to convince Alisa to confess and give up Malus' location in return for the chance to spend time with her. Meanwhile, Trish convinces Malcolm to help her find Malus, and Jessica discovers that Inez and Shane aren't what they seem.

episodes.title: AKA Three Lives and Counting
episodes.summary: After accidentally killing Dale, Jessica hallucinates Kilgrave coming to see her... and encouraging her to kill again. Meanwhile, Trish convinces Malus to provide her with his special treatment.

episodes.title: AKA Pray for My Patsy
episodes.summary: Alisa kills a police detective while trying to get to Trish, and her partner orders Jessica to let the police handle it. Meanwhile, Jeri plots her revenge against Shane and Inez.

episodes.title: AKA Playland
episodes.summary: Jessica finds herself on the run with her mother, and they make plans to leave the country. Meanwhile, Dorothy take charges of Trish's recovery, and Malcolm finishes his first case.

episodes.title: A.K.A The Perfect Burger
episodes.summary: Jessica picks up her mother's bad habit of hopefulness, and Dorothy hires her to find the missing Trish. Malcom has doubts about his job with Jeri, and Jeri reconnects with an old friend.

episodes.title: A.K.A You're Welcome
episodes.summary: While Jessica tries to sort out her life, Trish hones her skills with her newfound powers and learns the trials and tribulations of becoming a superhero.

episodes.title: A.K.A I Have No Spleen
episodes.summary: After getting Andrew's name from Trish and discharging herself from the hospital, Jessica goes after the person she believes is responsible for stabbing her. Jeri has lunch with Kith and then asks Malcolm to dig up some dirt on Kith's husband Peter.

episodes.title: A.K.A Customer Service is Standing By
episodes.summary: Jessica goes with Erik to track down the three people that he was blackmailing, figuring that one of them attacked her while trying to get at him. Malcolm digs up dirt on Peter, but Jeri hesitates to use it.

episodes.title: A.K.A I Wish
episodes.summary: Jessica teams up with Trish to bring down Gregory, and Gillian insists that the two of them have a heart-to-heart. After his secrets are revealed, Peter makes an Internet announcement that throws Jeri's life into turmoil.

episodes.title: A.K.A Sorry Face
episodes.summary: Jessica and Trish try to find Erik before it's too late. Jeri takes bagels to Peter's wake, and Malcolm pays a visit to Berry's pimp.

episodes.title: A.K.A The Double Half-Wappinger
episodes.summary: While Jessica and Trish travel to Gregory's home town to trace his career of serial killing, Malcolm is forced to choose between his job at the firm or helping Jessica.

episodes.title: A.K.A Camera Friendly
episodes.summary: Gregory sends Jessica a self-erasing video promising to kill another victim and expose her as a fraud. As the clock ticks down, Jessica and Trish try to find the serial killer's next victim. Jeri declares war on supers, and Malcolm and Zaya have a fight over his helping Jessica.

episodes.title: A.K.A I Did Something Today
episodes.summary: Gregory blackmails Jessica into destroying the evidence implicating him in Nathan's murder. Trish identifies Dorothy's body, and Laurent asks Jeri to help Kith.

episodes.title: A.K.A Hero Pants
episodes.summary: Jessica and Trish make preparations for Dorothy's funeral. Berry asks Malcolm for a favor after he and Zaya have an argument, and the police investigate Jessica's involvement with Carl's death.

episodes.title: A.K.A Hellcat
episodes.summary: Trish remembers her childhood as she teams with Erik to take down evil and clear Jessica's name.

episodes.title: A.K.A A Lotta Worms
episodes.summary: Jessica is forced to protect Gregory when Trish comes after him. After escaping her friend, Jessica falls into Gregory's clutches while Trish falls into Malcolm's hands.

episodes.title: A.K.A Everything
episodes.summary: When it's clear Trish has gone too far and has no intention of stopping, Jessica goes after her friend before she can kill again.
